summary: Interactive Demo Page Testing Complete - Iteration 8. All 17 tests passed. Successfully verified the new no-login-required demo experience. Demo page loads at /demo without authentication, shows demo banner with Sign Up Free button, industry selector works with all 4 industries (Healthcare, Agriculture, NGO, Market Research), all 6 tabs working (Dashboard, Forms, Submissions, Team, Map, Media), guided tour functionality working, and navigation buttons correctly redirect to /register.

backend_issues.note: Demo page uses static frontend data only - no backend API calls needed

working_features: Demo page loads at /demo without requiring login
Demo banner shows at top with animated sparkle icon and 'Sign Up Free' button
Industry selector dropdown works with 4 options (Healthcare & Clinical Research, Agriculture & Farming, NGO & Humanitarian, Market Research)
Dashboard tab shows stat cards (Total Submissions, Active Forms, Team Members, Avg Quality) with trends and charts
Forms tab shows list of sample forms with fields count, responses, status badges
Submissions tab shows sample submission data in table with filter tabs (All, Approved, Pending, Flagged)
Team tab shows sample team members with roles, submissions count, online status
Map tab shows animated GPS data points with pulse animations and tooltips
Media tab shows 6 sample photos in gallery with hover effects
Take a Tour button visible in sidebar with pulsing indicator
Guided Tour works with overlay, step navigation (Next/Back), step dots, and close functionality
Get Started Free button in sidebar navigates to /register
Sign Up Free button in banner navigates to /register
Login page has 'Try Interactive Demo' button that links to /demo
Locked buttons (Create Form, Export, Invite Member, etc.) show lock icon and prompt signup
